purpose: Teach: 国内外/使い分け/要員/分業/リモート/仕事場/スペック/スクロール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国内外の市場動向、毎週、私に、報告しろ。
lines.en: I want domestic and international market trends reported to me every week.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike delivery. Each phrase lands cleanly. Authority without theatricality. Expectation of compliance, not negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。語彙、相手に応じて、使い分ける訓練、社員に、徹底中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently drilling the staff on adapting their vocabulary depending on who they're addressing.
lines.style: Steady, competent tone. Matter-of-fact recitation of progress. Slight forward lean in phrasing — showing he's on top of it, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクト要員、来月、増員する方針だ。
lines.en: We're increasing project staffing next month. That's the plan.
lines.style: Declarative, final. No hedging. Short sentences that close doors. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製造ラインの分業体制、効率化を、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're streamlining the production line's division of labor.
lines.style: Straightforward, competent. Quick tempo. No padding. The report of someone executing on priorities, not asking permission.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: リモートワーク、定着させる方針で、いけ。
lines.en: Remote work is going to stick. Make it happen.
lines.style: Firm, economical phrasing. No room for debate. The voice of someone who's decided and is now assigning the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。私の仕事場、整理整頓を、心がけております。
lines.en: Yes. I've been keeping my workspace organized and maintain that discipline daily.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal register. Conscientious tone — showing care and responsibility without overstatement. A touch of earnestness underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品のスペック、競合に勝る形で、設定しろ。
lines.en: The new product specs need to outperform the competition. Set them that way.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Clear parameters. The tone expects the work is understood and will be done. Slight emphasis on the competitive edge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内SNS、画面、スクロール、しやすく、改修しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've updated the internal SNS interface so the scrolling is smoother and more intuitive.
lines.style: Efficient summary of completed work. Quiet confidence. Not seeking praise, just confirming the job is done. Professional close.
